resources.string: This screen changes the server address and Wi-Fi downloads. Server settings stay on the PC.
Tailscale or LAN address of the Drivebay PC. Include http:// and the port. 8765 is the usual port. 8766 is also common.
Tailscale is not installed. Download it from the Play Store and sign in to the same account as your PC, or skip and connect with a local address.
Download large files (50 MB and up) on Wi-Fi only
This address uses port %1$d, from the old 42000–42999 range. Drivebay’s usual port is 8765. 8766 is also common on PCs that already had 8765 in use.
No app can open this file
No app can share this file
Can’t save that link. Use the Download button in Drivebay.
Tap a server to connect. Hold it to rename or remove it.
Couldn\'t check for updates. Try again later.
The update didn\'t download. Try again later.
Allow installs from Drivebay, then tap Check for updates again.

Off until you turn it on. Shares the folders you pick, or all of internal storage if you opt in, and only on Tailscale or your home network. An owner password is required to start sharing or to pair and revoke PCs. Each PC gets its own 6-digit code and token. Several PCs can be connected at the same time. Revoke drops that PC immediately. A PC that was already paired stays connected after either side restarts. Paired PCs is under the share banner and in this section. Owner password sets or changes that password, and changing it asks for the current one.
Share this phone as a drive
This phone is shared as a drive
Name this PC, such as Work PC or Home PC. Leave it blank and Drivebay uses that PC\'s own name when it connects. Pairing adds a PC. It does not replace the ones you already have.
Type a name for this PC.
Revoke %1$s? That PC loses access immediately.
This password stays on the phone as a hash. It is required to start sharing and to pair or revoke a PC. It is not the password the PC uses.
Choose at least one folder first.
Waiting for Tailscale or Wi-Fi. Nothing is shared on a public network.

On this PC, sign in with username drivebay and either this 6-digit code or this token as the password. Both are shown once and belong to this PC only. The PC keeps them after the phone or the PC restarts.

Code: %1$s

Token:
%2$s

The code works only on Tailscale or your home network and turns off after 5 wrong tries. The token works anywhere the drive is shared. Other paired PCs keep their own code and token.

This shares all of internal storage, including Download, instead of only the folders you picked. Android needs you to turn on \"All files access\" for Drivebay on the next screen. Android/data and Android/obb stay hidden. You can turn this off any time.
Drivebay doesn\'t have All files access. Whole phone sharing is off.
Code locked. Pair that PC again.
Drivebay can\'t open the chosen folders anymore. Choose them again.
Port %1$d is already in use on this phone. Phone sharing is off.
Android blocked phone sharing. Open Drivebay and try again.
Phone sharing couldn\'t start (%1$s). Details are in Error log.
Drivebay hit an error last time. Settings › Error log has the details.
